name: Kujou Miyako
source:
"I want you to look for the culprit together with me."

[url=/c60020]Kakeru's[/url] classmate. Kujo is the heir apparent to a massive commercial conglomeration, not to mention a beautiful, well-mannered girl. Though she tends to be serious and straitlaced, she has flashes of humor. Between her earnest kindness and good looks, she's popular among both boys and girls.

Despite her family's affluence, she's quite the penny pincher and considers going out for fast food to be splurging. She works part-time at the café her grandfather owns, trying to build real-life experience and save money.

Kujo is a straight-A student, but she thinks of herself as hard-headed, so she values the protagonist's flexible mindset. Soon enough, she comes to rely on him, and it isn't long before she opens up and shows him her warmer side.

Having awakened to supernatural powers when she obtained a mysterious piece of jewelry, an Artifact, she's driven by her strong sense of justice to solve the mysteries around town.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/976390/]Steam[/url]]

[spoiler]Her ability allows her to steal things on a range of 10 meters and even makes the former owner forget about the stolen item. The stolen object is not restricted to physical means; it can be sight or memories, and the user should know the target very well.[/spoiler]
